sports.headline: Messi becomes first player to win back-to-back MLS Golden Boots
sports.summary: Inter Miami's Lionel Messi finished the 2026 regular season with a league-high 26 goals in 31 games. That made him the first player in MLS history to win consecutive Golden Boots, after 29 goals in 2025. The 39-year-old signed an Inter Miami extension through 2028 last month. He is also favourite for MVP as Miami head into the playoffs as the East's No. 2 seed.

sports.headline: Nestlé Confectionery becomes Official Partner of Everton Women in multi-year deal
sports.summary: Nestlé Confectionery has signed a multi-year deal as Official Chocolate and Grab Bag Sweet Partner of Everton Women. Everton calls it an important step in the team's growth. Trade coverage frames it as a sign that major consumer-goods brands see women's football as a way to reach families and younger consumers.

fashion.headline: Martine Rose named Balenciaga creative director, first woman to lead the house
fashion.summary: Kering and Balenciaga confirmed the British-Jamaican designer as creative director on 6 November. She succeeds Pierpaolo Piccioli, whose exit was announced only hours earlier after less than two years in the role. Rose previously consulted on menswear under Demna and starts on 16 November 2026. Marie Claire describes her as the first woman to lead the house creatively in its 109-year history.

marketing.headline: Etsy CMO Brad Minor on breaking down channel silos and the Olivia Rodrigo partnership
marketing.summary: Ad Age's Brand Marketer of the Month profile looks at how Etsy's CMO has pursued a customer-centric approach across previously siloed departments. It covers the human-first brand anthem and the partnership with Olivia Rodrigo, and ties them to the company's results.

marketing.headline: JD Sports launches global 'Create The New' Christmas campaign led by musicians, athletes and creators
marketing.summary: JD Sports unveiled its global Christmas 2026 campaign on 6 November. The cast is led by dance-music artists Sammy Virji, Josh Baker and Chris Stassy, alongside footballers Ferran Torres and Lauren James and creators including Skye Newman. It frames the festive period as a time to keep creating rather than leaning on nostalgia, and links to Nike, adidas Originals, New Balance, Salomon and On product. It is a seasonal retail campaign, so it ranks low.
